limitations: Small locally reviewed dataset; not a universal navigation guarantee.
Two close test panels localized the correct door but covered only part of the annotated box (IoU < 0.5).
Target means pink door, whether sleeping, awake, or viewed from behind. It never authorizes F or skipping combat.
No learned enemy or card class is enabled.
fine_tuned_from: Prior local checkpoint; three reviewed night exits with avatar occlusion plus 36 brightness variants, retaining prior splits and negatives.
validation_limit: Original validation/test groups unchanged. New night-exit views are training/calibration only. Six independent periodic wins are verified; the ten-win target remains incomplete.
